metadata.logline: After defying her own despair to cure a fever-stricken village boy with her mother's herbal remedies, Lady Juliana learns that the Dowager Duchess is secretly withering away from a mysterious illness inside Ashbury Manor.
metadata.continuity_notes: Directly follows Episode 20's cliffhanger where Catherine and Rupert plotted to seize Ashbury upon the Dowager Duchess's demise; in the village, Juliana puts aside her grief over her burned cottage to save young Toby, stumbling upon critical intelligence regarding the manor.

events.text: Medium shot of Lady Juliana in a rustic grey gown, her wrists wrapped in white bandages, smoothing a blanket over a straw pallet in the dimly lit barn.
Lady Juliana gently straightens the grey wool blanket over the hay bed, exhaling a soft, exhausted sigh.
A loud wooden slam as the heavy double barn doors violently fly open.
Wide shot framing the open doorway against the overcast daylight as Prudence, a young village girl in an apron, rushes inside, frantic and weeping.
"Lady Juliana! Please! You have to help me, Toby is dying!"
events.speaker: PRUDENCE

events.text: Lady Juliana hurries over, placing her bandaged hands reassuringly on Prudence's trembling shoulders.
Medium close-up of Lady Juliana looking into Prudence's tearful face with compassionate urgency.
"Oh dear. Breathe. Tell me what has happened."
events.speaker: LADY JULIANA

events.text: Close-up of Prudence weeping, clutching her hands to her chest in agony.
"My little brother Toby... his chest is burning! He cannot breathe!"
events.speaker: PRUDENCE

events.text: Close-up of Lady Juliana, her brow furrowing with concern.
"Tell me what the apothecary said. Did he not give you medicine?"
events.speaker: LADY JULIANA

events.text: Close-up of Prudence, her face twisted in bitter anguish as she gestures back toward the rain-soaked outdoors.
"He shut the door in my face because we have no silver!"
events.speaker: PRUDENCE

events.text: Wide shot of Lady Juliana and Prudence facing each other inside the wooden barn, dust motes drifting in the pale light.
"The manor doctor laughed! He said village boys are not worth his time!"
events.speaker: PRUDENCE

events.text: Medium profile shot of Lady Juliana looking down at her bandaged hands, holding Prudence's hand with somber heartache.
"We have no clinic now."
events.speaker: LADY JULIANA

events.text: "Our cottage is ashes. I have nothing left but this coltsfoot."
events.speaker: LADY JULIANA

events.text: Prudence drops desperately to her knees onto the hay-strewn barn floor, clasping her hands in tearful supplication.
High-angle looking down at Prudence kneeling before Lady Juliana, pleading upward.
"He is only seven! If you do not come, he will die! You are his only hope, Lady Juliana!"
events.speaker: PRUDENCE

events.text: Lady Juliana immediately reaches down and pulls Prudence firmly back to her feet, then turns to snatch her heavy leather-bound herbal ledger from the wooden workbench.
Medium shot framing the barn entrance as Lady Juliana lifts Prudence up, grabs her book, and leads the way out.
"Stand up. Sinking to your knees will not save him. Let me grab my ledger. We go now."
events.speaker: LADY JULIANA

events.text: Tracking wide shot following Lady Juliana and Prudence running side by side along a muddy, puddled village road past thatched stone cottages under a gloomy, overcast sky.
Lady Juliana clutches the thick book to her chest as she and Prudence sprint swiftly through the village.
Low-angle medium shot of seven-year-old Toby lying on a makeshift straw pallet before a roaring fireplace, coughing weakly.
Heavy, raspy chest coughs echoing in the small room, accompanied by crackling hearth fire.
Lady Juliana rushes in, sets the ledger on the rustic wooden table, and quickly flips open the pages.
Close-up of Lady Juliana rapidly scanning the botanical illustrations and handwritten remedies in the book.
"His skin is burning hot."
events.speaker: LADY JULIANA

events.text: Lady Juliana places her bandaged hand against Toby's flushed, sweating forehead as he wheezes painfully.
Medium close-up of Lady Juliana tending to Toby, with Prudence standing anxiously in the background.
"Prudence, fetch hot water immediately!"
events.speaker: LADY JULIANA

events.text: Medium shot of Prudence nodding rapidly, rushing toward the stone hearth.
"Yes! Right away, I will get it!"
events.speaker: PRUDENCE

events.text: Prudence wraps a cloth around the iron handle of the steaming kettle resting over the hearth fire and lifts it.
Close-up top-down view of Lady Juliana's bandaged fingers gently touching an ink illustration of chamomile flowers in the open ledger.
"I cannot let my own weariness stop me. This boy needs my mother's knowledge."
events.speaker: LADY JULIANA

events.text: Lady Juliana crushes dried herbal leaves into a dark wooden bowl between her bandaged hands, then pours steaming water over them from the kettle.
Close-up of hot water pouring into the bowl, releasing aromatic vapors from the dried herbs.
Lady Juliana sits beside the pallet and brings the steaming herbal bowl close to Toby's face while Prudence cradles his shoulders.
Medium shot of Lady Juliana, Prudence, and Toby huddled together by the warm glow of the fire.
"Lift his shoulders, Prudence. Hold the steam close. Let him inhale."
events.speaker: LADY JULIANA

events.text: Close-up of Prudence supporting Toby's head, whispering tenderly into his ear.
"Like this? Toby, breathe it in, sweet boy."
events.speaker: PRUDENCE

events.text: Close-up of Lady Juliana gently waving her hand to direct the medicinal steam toward Toby's nose and mouth.
"Yes, just like that. Keep breathing, Toby. Let the vapor clear your chest."
events.speaker: LADY JULIANA

events.text: Toby's strained wheezing eases into quiet, rhythmic breathing as he slips into peaceful sleep on his pillow.
Close-up of Toby's face relaxing, his chest falling still and calm.
Close-up of Prudence covering her mouth in overwhelmed relief, tears streaming down her face.
"Oh, thank God! His chest is quiet! The rattling has stopped!"
events.speaker: PRUDENCE

events.text: Lady Juliana pulls the plaid wool blanket snug over Toby's chest, smiling softly with profound relief.
Medium shot of Lady Juliana sitting on a stool beside Toby's bedside, placing a cup of coltsfoot tea on a small wooden table.
"Keep him warm. Give him three drops of this coltsfoot tea every morning."
events.speaker: LADY JULIANA

events.text: Medium close-up of Prudence looking at Lady Juliana with awe and boundless gratitude, her hands clasped in front of her.
"You saved him. The grand doctors left him to choke, but you..."
events.speaker: PRUDENCE

events.text: "I have no money, Lady Juliana, but I swear on my life, I will do anything to repay you."
events.speaker: PRUDENCE

events.text: Lady Juliana takes Prudence's trembling hands into hers, smiling with heartfelt warmth.
Close-up of Lady Juliana comforting Prudence warmly.
"Your brother's breath is payment enough for me, Prudence."
events.speaker: LADY JULIANA

events.text: Low-angle shot past sleeping Toby toward Prudence standing in the room, her expression darkening with anger.
"At the grand manor, they ignore us. They only care about their own luxury."
events.speaker: PRUDENCE

events.text: "But their gold cannot buy them health."
events.speaker: PRUDENCE

events.text: Lady Juliana turns sharply, her eyes widening with sudden recognition.
Close-up of Lady Juliana looking directly into Prudence's eyes with startled concern.
"What do you mean? Is someone ill? The Dowager Duchess?"
events.speaker: LADY JULIANA

events.text: Low-angle cut to Toby sleeping peacefully as the fire crackles behind him.
"She is dying, Lady Juliana."
events.speaker: PRUDENCE

events.text: Close-up of Prudence leaning in close to Lady Juliana, whispering with grave intensity.
"A strange, mysterious illness is eating her away."
events.speaker: PRUDENCE

events.text: "Inside that massive house with all their wealth, she is fading to nothing, and no one can stop it."
events.speaker: PRUDENCE

events.text: Brief cut back to Toby sleeping peacefully on his straw pillow by the warm fireplace.

Lady Juliana sits motionless at the rustic wooden table, her bandaged hands holding open her late mother's leather-bound herbal ledger. Her eyes reflect deep apprehension as the dire truth settles over her.
Slow push-in on Lady Juliana staring down at the ancient pages, her expression filled with profound realization and growing resolve as dramatic strings swell to a gripping cliffhanger.
